shortDescription: Resolve account defaults and primary group information

options.name: default_user
options.description: Fallback account name used when O(user) is omitted or empty.

options.name: fail_on_missing_user
options.description: Fail when the resolved user does not exist in the local account database. If set to C(false), missing user information is returned without failing.

options.name: group
options.description: Explicit group name to use. If omitted or empty, the primary group of the resolved user is detected.

options.name: user
options.description: Explicit account name to use. If omitted or empty, O(default_user) is used.
